hello.note: chào drops low, like a sigh; xin stays level.

good_morning.note: Textbook phrase; most people just say xin chào.

good_evening.note: Also textbook; xin chào works all evening.

goodbye.note: Both syllables land low and stop short.

how_are_you.note: Bạn suits a peer; for an elder use anh or chị.

thank_you.note: cảm dips down then back up; ơn stays level.

no_problem.note: In the north gì sounds like 'zee', not 'gee'.

please.note: Rarely said alone; politeness rides on pronouns.

excuse_me.note: Same phrase as 'sorry'; also used to squeeze past.

yes.note: Vâng is the northern polite yes; the south says dạ.

slang.note: Youth slang for 'awesome'; fine with peers.

delicious.note: Start ngon like the ng in 'singer'.

cheers.note: At the table you'll also hear 'một, hai, ba, dô!'
